  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['f24'], df['f25'] + df['f26'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6)"
      ],
      "features": ["f24", "f25", "f26"],
      "rationale": "f24 is defined as the sum of f25 and f26."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f01'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f12'], df['f07'] * 8 / df['f01'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f12", "f07", "f01"],
      "rationale": "Source bits per second is derived from source bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f01'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f13'], df['f08'] * 8 / df['f01'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f13", "f08", "f01"],
      "rationale": "Destination bits per second is derived from destination bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 0, df['f27'] == np.floor(df['f07'] / df['f05']), True)",
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 0, df['f27'] == np.round(df['f07'] / df['f05']), True)",
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 0, df['f27'] == df['f07'] // df['f05'], True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f27", "f07", "f05"],
      "rationale": "Mean packet size transmitted by source is total source bytes divided by source packet count, possibly rounded or truncated."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 0, df['f28'] == np.floor(df['f08'] / df['f06']), True)",
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 0, df['f28'] == np.round(df['f08'] / df['f06']), True)",
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 0, df['f28'] == df['f08'] // df['f06'], True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f28", "f08", "f06"],
      "rationale": "Mean packet size transmitted by destination is total destination bytes divided by destination packet count, possibly rounded or truncated."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f16'], df['f01'] / df['f05'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)",
        "np.where(df['f05'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f16'], df['f01'] / (df['f05'] - 1), rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f16", "f01", "f05"],
      "rationale": "Source interpacket arrival time is duration divided by packet count or count minus one."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f17'], df['f01'] / df['f06'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)",
        "np.where(df['f06'] > 1, np.isclose(df['f17'], df['f01'] / (df['f06'] - 1), rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f17", "f01", "f06"],
      "rationale": "Destination interpacket arrival time is duration divided by packet count or count minus one."
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['f01'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f09'], df['f05'] / df['f01'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)",
        "np.where(df['f01'] > 0, np.isclose(df['f09'], (df['f05'] + df['f06']) / df['f01'], rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-6), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["f09", "f05", "f06", "f01"],
      "rationale": "f09 is undocumented but likely a rate (packets per second) based on packet counts and duration."
    }
  ]
}
